### Suppressed comments (1)

**crates/sparq-engine/src/exec.rs:4289**
* When `reuse_rhs` is false, `capped_rhs` puts the scan in `uncached`, but the new `*_ref` joins only borrow it. That keeps the entire RHS alive through the rest of the block (and `record_pattern_ndv`) instead of dropping it when the old consuming join returned, so armed-budget queries can have a substantially larger peak working set despite the intended no-retention path. Drop the uncached RHS immediately after the join dispatch (or scope the borrow) before continuing.
